messages:
Tom: Heads up: Nimbus POC saw trial credits go negative (-$0.45) and then started receiving 429s during batch evals. Can we swarm? @Maya
Maya: Oof. Account name? Any request ids/screenshots?
Tom: nimbus-poc-21. Customer attached console screenshot and one response header: x-rwd-req: rwd-req-20260505-c9d1.
Rajat: Likely retry+parallelism or duplicate accounting events. Ask for sample curl and whether they used SDK retries.
Tom: They ran 40 parallel CI jobs with default SDK retries (2). Sample curl attached in thread.
Maya: Deploy-bot, pull ingest/accounting logs for rwd-req-20260505-c9d1 and account nimbus-poc-21 around 2026-05-05T02:45.
deploy-bot: Returning condensed logs...
Rajat: Ingest shows same request processed twice before dedupe confirmed: two tokens_consumed a second apart. Accounting has two matching events.
Maya: So double-bill triggered burst quota -> 429s. We'll need ops hotfix and a billing adjustment.
Tom: Can we offer immediate mitigations to customer?
Rajat: Recommend: lower client retries, reduce parallelism, and temporarily enforce per-key rate caps. We'll patch ingest to wait for dedupe confirmation before emitting accounting events.
billing-bot: Placed provisional credit hold for nimbus-poc-21 pending ops verification. Ticket BILL-9133 created.
Maya: I'll notify the customer with timeline, mitigation steps, and that billing team will follow up once we confirm event export. Thanks everyone.
